title: 'Salem's Lot
author: Stephen King
summary: A writer returns to his Maine hometown just as a mysterious pair of antiques dealers move into the old house on the hill. As residents begin to change, a few people realise what is happening.
readIf: you like small-town horror with a cast of ordinary people and a traditional vampire threat.
skipIf: you want a modern, glamorous take on vampires.

pairings.reason: The original vampire novel that this book directly echoes and updates.
A very different, melancholy and intimate take on vampires.
Another King story about a town with a hidden evil, with a stronger focus on friendship.
